title: CNTi Test Suite results file
description: Schema for the cnti/results/cnti-testsuite-results-<timestamp>.yml file produced by a completed CNTi Test Suite run. Matches schema_version 1. The file is YAML; this schema validates it as JSON (YAML is a JSON superset).

testsuite_version.description: Version of the test suite that produced the file.

schema_version.description: Version of this results-file schema; bumped on breaking changes.

status.description: Overall run verdict, derived from exit_code (0 -> passed, 1 -> failed, 2 -> error). `running` while the run is in progress - a file still saying `running` belongs to a run that did not finish.

command.description: The command line that produced this file.

exit_code.description: Process exit code: 0 = passed, 1 = failed (a required test failed), 2 = error (a test raised). null while the run is in progress (status `running`).

tools.description: Versions of the tools whose verdicts this file contains, as pinned by the test suite: kubescape and the regolibrary release its framework comes from, the kyverno CLI and the policies branch, and LitmusChaos. Two runs that disagree with different values here measured with different rulers.

kubescape_framework.description: Kubescape framework the security tests read their controls from.

kubescape_regolibrary.description: Release of kubescape/regolibrary the framework was downloaded from.

kyverno_policies.description: Branch of kyverno/policies the audit policies are taken from.

items.description: One entry per test that ran.

summary.description: Aggregate numbers for the run, scoped to the tests that actually ran.

max_passed.description: Maximum number of tests that could have passed (denominator for 'X of Y tests passed').

maximum_points.description: Maximum points achievable by the tests that ran.

criteria.description: Success criterion verdicts, one per task group that ran, in evaluation order. A group's dependencies run before its body, so the last entry is the outermost group and its verdict decides exit_code. Absent when no group with a declared criterion ran.

group.description: Task group the criterion belongs to.

scope.description: points.yml tag whose tests count toward the criterion; defaults to the group name.

min_passed.description: Minimum number of tests in scope that must pass.

passed.description: True when the group met its criterion.

min_ratio.description: Minimum share of the tests in scope that must pass, as a fraction of how many exist rather than how many ran. Null when the group sets no ratio.

declared_count.description: How many tests in scope are declared, the denominator min_ratio is taken against.

max_failed.description: How many tests in scope may fail; null for no limit, meaning the group's other thresholds already account for failures.

type.description: The test's declared type (essential, normal, bonus).

details.description: Free-form reason/evidence strings. Present only when non-empty.

remediation.description: Guidance on how to fix the failure. Present only when non-empty.

impacted_resources.description: Structured list of offending resources. Present only when non-empty.

excepted.description: Findings covered by a documented exception in the CNF's config (CBPP-0003), with the reason. Present only when non-empty.

excepted_finding.description: A finding the CNF's config declares an exception for: what was found, where, and the documented reason it is allowed.

impacted_resource.description: A resource that caused or participated in a test's result. Only fields that are known are recorded.
